svg.title: Master bedroom air-handler node: PROTO-SHIELD lead holes
svg.text: PROTO-SHIELD rev A: the proto area enlarged, component side
Scales to fit one page. Columns c1–c13 left to right, rows r1–r14 top to bottom; the small holes between the columns are the 3V3 (orange) and GND (black) buses.
Parts are outlines under the pads. Ring: a part's lead hole. Pink pad: a joint on the 5 V rail. Dot: a solder-side wire lands here.
Lead holes, x and y in mm
and r14; c7 r1; c13 r1.
A0 tail: c11 r13 and r14 → A0 inner pad
A1 tail: c12 r11 to r14 → A1 inner pad
